Description
elec calc SOLAR allows you to design and size a photovoltaic installation as a complete electrical installation, from direct current through to AC usages and grid connection.
Built on the elec calc calculation engine, the software natively integrates the sizing of module strings, inverters and their MPPT inputs, together with the full associated electrical installation: switchboards, protections, cabling and site usages including EV charging, self-consumption and generic loads. Grid connection can be sized in low voltage or through an MV transformer.
Unlike standard PV simulation tools, which stop at the inverter or impose predefined circuit templates, elec calc SOLAR allows free-form modelling of the electrical architecture: every project reflects the installation exactly as it will be built, with no predefined scheme.
Engineering firms and installers work from a single model for the entire DC and AC sizing process, compliant with IEC 60364-7-712 and local low-voltage standards (AREI, BS, NEN, IEC).
Features
PV modelling
Free-form modelling of the PV field: strings, MPPT inputs, inverters, with no imposed architecture
Intelligent string assignment with automatic MPPT range verification
Automatic alerts on configuration inconsistencies
Suited to all installation types: rooftops, carports, ground-mounted plants
Full electrical sizing
Cable sizing and protection device calculation, DC and AC
Power flow analysis with real-time visualisation
Dynamic power balance
Multi-source short-circuit current calculation
DC and AC voltage drop control
Built-in compliance
Automatic application of IEC 60364-7-712 (DC side)
Compliance verification down to the point of delivery (AC side, per local LV standard: AREI, BS, NEN, IEC)
Lightning risk analysis and DC/AC surge protection management
On-diagram anomaly icons linking directly to the relevant standard reference
Grid connection
Low-voltage sizing
MV transformer integration
Extension to MV networks by combining the SOLAR module with elec calc HT/BT, BIM or GRID
Database
Over 12,000 manufacturer references: modules, inverters, DC and AC protections, surge protection devices
Regularly updated database, with automatic recommendation of suitable equipment
Continuity with archelios PRO
Direct import of the PV architecture (strings, MPPT, inverters) with no re-entry of data
Automated documentation
Calculation reports, electrical diagrams and bills of materials generated in one click
Recommended configuration
Windows® 11, 32 GB RAM, minimum 20 GB free disk space, full HD display recommended (1920 x 1080), Intel® Core i5 processor minimum, internet connection required for installation and updates.

Description
elec calc advantages are focused to ensure safety, service continuity and energy efficiency according the different standards worldwide (IEC, NFC15 -100, RGIE,…)
elec calc provides engineers, installers, developers, energy producers & distributors and electrical switchgear manufacturers, with a powerful tool for sizing electrical installations. It includes calculation models with the highest performance on the market, in the field of design and calculation, ensuring the rapid development of your projects and high quality electrical calculations.

elec calc offers numerous advantages such as its increased safety, service continuity and energy efficiency according to the different standards worldwide (IEC, NFC 15-100, RGIE,…)
The current version of elec calc has been developed thanks to the extensive experience of Trace Software International. It includes performance guarantees, necessary for sizing electrical installations in both high and low voltage electrical projects, in various industries such as energy, infrastructure, and critical facilities engineering.
The sizing of elec calc projects will allow you to reduce costs and the time spent designing, while ensuring the correct running of the installation according to different standards.
